slots.note: Inner drawings — final reveal. Replaced by the CTA widget if more.png is present.

named_slots.note: CTA widget image (auto-probed as more.jpg / more.png / more.webp etc.). When present, replaces slot 11 at the end of the narrative and becomes clickable.
named_slots.discovery: Probed automatically as 'more' filename in the narrative asset folder.

named_slots.note: URL opened in a full-screen iframe overlay when the CTA widget is clicked. Set via urls.txt: 'more: more.html' or any absolute URL.

notes: Place numbered layer files as assets/skins/<NARRATIVE_ID>/1.jpg (or .png, .webp, .svg) through 11.*
All layers use mix-blend-mode: screen except slot 1 (baseRoom), which uses normal blend.
Default scene choreography is tuned for exactly 3 narrative elements (N004 / C051).
With fewer or more elements, a simple linear interpolation is used between scene keyframes.
CTA widget: place more.png (image) and add 'more: more.html' to urls.txt for the full setup.
If only more.html is configured (no more.png), the standard Para saber mais button is shown instead.
